newsitem.title: UK: Randgold to list exloration arm in London.
newsitem.headline: Randgold to list exloration arm in London.

text.p: South Africa's Randgold and Exploration Company Ltd, expects to list its international exploration and mining offshoot Randgold Resources on the London Stock Exchange before the end of June and launch one of the biggest initial public offerings in London for over 10 years, the Financial Times said on Monday.
The terms will value Randgold Resources at about 400 million pounds while Randgold will raise about 100 million pounds, the paper said.
"Resources is a serious long-term company and it is more appropriate for it to list in London," the FT quoted Randgold chairman Peter Flack as saying.
He said it would probably also be listed on the U.S.'s Nasdaq and also with an emerging marke t.
Randgold's holding in Randgold Resources will be reduced from 78 percent to about 54 percent after the listing, the FT said.
